title: Text: DET Dan Griesbaum ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: You don’t have to tell me if you already have him but Marc Himelstein is probably a name that could yield more info
Ok...are you done with work yet?
Yes. Started with the USPBL- VP of Sales
I don’t think we’ve done much - if anything - on the USPBL so let me know if I can help in that regard. I’ll give you a ring this week, I gotta get back on the horse of this story after the holiday

Yea that would be great...I think there are definitely interesting stories to be had there. Positive stuff but also applicable to the tigers in that there are other interesting opportunities out there for baseball fans. Talk to you soon- thanks
